facts.fact: A Bahir Dar University Journal of Law article treats the 2016 Computer Crime Proclamation as Ethiopia's current cybercrime law, which it says significantly amended earlier offences, and describes a 2019 draft Computer Crime Proclamation as a further proposed reform.

ETH.note: Abstract concerns computer crime law only; states nothing on data protection.
